notes.title: Patch 1.2 now available
notes.notes:
Fixed a few bugs in the game
- The pause menu was not showing when pressing ESC
- Added roll in the game to dodge enemy attacks
- Created a few UI's to help guide the players better
- Fixed the door when inserting a key 
- Enemy hit slower 

- If you have more questions or other bugs, please contact KevMinGaming@gmail.com

notes.title: Fixed bug
notes.notes:
After viewing some gameplay, I noticed that the game needed more guidance for players to play my game. I apologize for the late update, I am a lone developer and I am trying my best to make my game enjoyable for everyone. 

I would like to thank the player for being patient and playing my game in the early stages.

As mentioned, my game has maintenance for various bugs that got fixed. The game update will be available today.
